title: Moses' radiant face and the veil
description: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the testimony, the skin of his face shone because he had been speaking with the Lord. Aaron and the Israelites were afraid to come near him, but Moses called them to himself and gave them all that the Lord had commanded on the mountain. Afterward, he put a veil over his face, but took it off whenever he went in before the Lord to speak with him.
